resources.string:
Namaste! Main Sahayak hoon, aapka personal AI assistant.

Naya dark theme + naye commands:
• "open whatsapp"
• "youtube lofi study mix"
• "timer 5 minute"
• "alarm 7 am"
• "date kya hai"
• "search india news"
• "call 9876543210"
AI chat ke liye Settings me Gemini API key daalo (free: aistudio.google.com/apikey).
Namaste! Main Sahayak hoon. Kya madad karun?
"%1$s" naam ka app install nahi mila.
Number samajh nahi aaya. Jaise likho: call 9876543210
Timer set kiya: %1$s — clock app khul raha hai, "Start" aap khud dabana.
Alarm set kiya: %1$s — "OK" aap khud dabana.
YouTube par search kar raha hoon: %1$s
WhatsApp khol raha hoon — message ka draft ready hoga, "Send" aap khud dabana.
API key aistudio.google.com/apikey se free me banao. Key sirf aapke phone par save hoti hai — kisi ko mat dena. Model default gemini-2.0-flash hai (free tier).
